RAR 1.5, 2.0 and 2.9 sample archives from the test fixtures of the [rars](https://crates.io/crates/rars) crate
(0.12.3), under the Apache-2.0 license. `rar250_*.rar` are its `rar250/AUDIO.RAR`, `BIGLZ.RAR` and `SOLID.RAR`.
The `rarvm_*` archives each use one of RAR 3's standard filters; `ppmd_lz_match_rar300.rar` opens with a PPMd block.
